responsibility: `rustc_ty_utils` provides shared type-system utility queries that bridge type checking and code generation. Its crate root (`lib.rs`) assembles these utilities and registers the query providers used by the rest of the compiler. The crate computes callable ABI details in `abi.rs`, producing normalized `FnAbi` data for functions, closures, coroutine-closures, shims, and intrinsics; resolves concrete callable codegen instances in `instance.rs`, including trait dispatch, drop glue, async-drop glue, and builtin shims; and computes type layout in `layout.rs` while `layout_sanity_check.rs` verifies the internal consistency of those `TyAndLayout` results. It answers core semantic type queries in `ty.rs`, such as parameter-environment normalization, defaultness/asyncness metadata, `Sized` constraints, special impl classification, and unsizing-participation of ADT parameters, and `common_traits.rs` adds fast queries for ubiquitous lang-item traits like `Copy`, `Sized`, `Freeze`, and `Unpin`. For type validity and destruction behavior, `representability.rs` checks ADTs for finite representable structure, while `needs_drop.rs` determines whether types require drop or async-drop glue, whether destructors are significant, and which subtypes contribute to dropping. The crate also supports higher-level type reasoning around constants and bounds: `consts.rs` destructures evaluated constants and builds abstract constants for generic const expressions; `implied_bounds.rs` computes the well-formed types that yield implied bounds for items and RPITIT-related desugarings; and `assoc.rs` builds associated-item metadata, maps trait items to impl items, and synthesizes RPITIT associated types. Finally, `errors.rs` defines the diagnostics these utilities emit, covering failures such as drop-analysis overflow, unsupported abstract-const operations, malformed SIMD types, unexpected function-pointer associated items, and invalid opaque-type generic arguments. Together, these modules make `rustc_ty_utils` the compiler’s central provider of reusable type-layout, ABI, instance-resolution, drop-analysis, representability, associated-item, implied-bound, and constant-structure utilities.
